name: observed_at
description: Instant of the reading, UTC. For precipitation, rain, snowfall and wind_gusts_10m: the END of the hour the value covers.

name: local_date
description: New York calendar day this hour belongs to (partition column).

name: precipitation
description: Total precipitation (rain, showers, snow water) in the preceding hour, mm.

name: rain
description: Rain in the preceding hour, mm.

name: snowfall
description: Snowfall in the preceding hour, cm.

name: wind_speed_10m
description: Wind speed 10 m above ground, km/h.

name: wind_gusts_10m
description: Maximum gust in the preceding hour, 10 m above ground, km/h.

name: weather_code
description: WMO weather interpretation code (0 clear … 95+ thunderstorm).
